name: home-assistant-connector
description: Connect Anna agents and apps to your own Home Assistant instance for entity states, Assist conversations, and opt-in device actions.
author: Eric McCormick

credentials.name: HA_URL
credentials.description: HTTPS base URL, e.g. https://example.home:8123. No path or slash after port.

credentials.name: HA_TOKEN
credentials.description: Create in Home Assistant profile. Never share in a conversation.

credentials.name: HA_ENABLE_CONTROL
credentials.description: Set true to allow write operations. Leave false for read-only plus Assist.

credentials.name: HA_ALLOW_LOCAL_HTTP
credentials.description: Set true ONLY on a trusted local Agent/LAN. Token will travel unencrypted.

tools.name: test_connection
tools.description: Verify the configured Home Assistant URL/token and report server name and version. Does not expose credentials.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Read a Home Assistant entity state and attributes by entity_id, e.g. sensor.living_room_temperature.

parameters.name: entity_id
parameters.description: Home Assistant entity id such as sensor.temperature

tools.name: list_states
tools.description: List up to 100 Home Assistant entity states, optionally filtered to one domain. Read-only.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Optional entity domain such as light, sensor, or switch

tools.name: converse
tools.description: Send a text request to the configured Home Assistant Assist conversation agent and return its reply. CAUTION: some Assist agents can control devices.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Optional Home Assistant conversation agent ID

tools.name: call_service
tools.description: Opt-in device control. Allowlisted light/switch/fan/climate/scene/automation/script actions only. Automations/scripts may have sensitive effects; ask the user before triggering. Requires HA_ENABLE_CONTROL=true.

tools.name: fire_event
tools.description: Opt-in Home Assistant event trigger. Events can activate automations with physical effects; ask the user before triggering. Requires HA_ENABLE_CONTROL=true.
